**1Astronomy & Astrophysics manuscript no. (will be inserted by hand later)**

*The extreme r-element rich, iron-poor halo giant CS 31082-001*

20 pp, 22 sections.

**Abstract.** We present a high-resolution (R=75,000, S/N ∼ 500) spectroscopic analysis of the bright (V=11.7), extreme halo giant CS 31082-001 ([Fe/H] = −2.9), obtained in an ESO-VLT Large Programme dedicated to very metal-poor stars. We ﬁnd CS 31082-001 to be extremely rich in r-process elements, comparable in this respect only to the similarly metal-poor, but carbon-enriched, giant CS 22892-052 . As a result of the extreme overabundance of the heaviest r-process elements, and negligible blending from CH and CN mo lecular lines, a reliable measurement is obtained of the U II line at 386 nm, for the ﬁrst time in a halo star, along with numerous lines of Th II, as well as lines of 25 other r-process elements. Abundance estimates for a total of 43 ele ments (44 counting Hydrogen) are reported in CS 31082-001 , almost half of the entire perio dic table.
